{
 "path": "/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-openclaw-luna6-medium-fresh0/frozen/held-out-reference/play/users/u054/system/state/workspace/programs/task-5fdac41e.py",
 "content": "from collections import deque

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen = set()
    components = []
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == 0 or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            q = deque([(r, c)])
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while q:
                y, x = q.popleft()
                cells.append((y, x))
                for dy, dx in ((1, 0), (-1, 0), (0, 1), (0, -1)):
                    yy, xx = y + dy, x + dx
                    if 0 <= yy < h and 0 <= xx < w and (yy, xx) not in seen and grid[yy][xx] == color:
                        seen.add((yy, xx))
                        q.append((yy, xx))
            minr = min(y for y, x in cells)
            maxr = max(y for y, x in cells)
            minc = min(x for y, x in cells)
            maxc = max(x for y, x in cells)
            components.append((minc, color, maxr - minr + 1, maxc - minc + 1,
                               [(y - minr, x - minc) for y, x in cells]))
    components.sort(key=lambda item: item[0])
    if not components:
        return [[0]]
    placements = []
    r0 = c0 = 0
    for _, color, bh, bw, cells in components:
        placements.append((r0, c0, color, cells))
        r0 += bh - 1
        c0 += bw - 1
    out_h = max(r + max(y for y, x in cells) for r, c, color, cells in placements) + 1
    out_w = max(c + max(x for y, x in cells) for r, c, color, cells in placements) + 1
    out = [[0] * out_w for _ in range(out_h)]
    for r, c, color, cells in placements:
        for y, x in cells:
            out[r + y][c + x] = color
    return out
"
}
